name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Cyclone Murasu weakens inland after Andhra Pradesh landfall; GDACS red alert
state: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast near Ongole between about 01:00 and 05:30 local time on 3 Nov with winds of 100–110km/h, gusting to 120km/h, and was forecast to weaken to a deep depression by midnight (NationPath). About 10,000 people were evacuated and no deaths had been reported. GDACS still listed a red alert on 3 Nov.
for_you: Follow India Meteorological Department and local authority warnings if in coastal Andhra Pradesh.

sources.title: NationPath — Cyclone Murasu completes landfall near Ongole

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
